BrochureContent.Content:
32A Ralahine is a charming, detached home set on a corner site in a mature and family-friendly neighbourhood in Ballybrack, Co. Dublin. Presented in a beautiful condition throughout, this lovely home offers bright, comfortable and well-proportioned accommodation.

The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, living room, kitchen and dining room, two bedrooms and a contemporary shower room. Outside, the property is approached through a walled low maintenance front garden with colourful planting, giving the home a lovely sense of privacy. To the rear is a large, private and low maintenance cobblelock garden, which also provides convenient off street parking. Its sunny orientation makes it an ideal space for relaxing, entertaining or simply enjoying the outdoors.

32A Ralahine is ideally positioned to enjoy everything the surrounding area has to offer. Killiney Shopping Centre is close by, while the nearby villages and towns of Dalkey, Killiney, Cabinteely and Dún Laoghaire provide an excellent selection of shops, cafés, restaurants and local amenities. 

There is no shortage of recreational options nearby, including Rochestown Lodge & Health Club, tennis, squash and scuba diving clubs. The beautiful coastline is also within easy reach, with Sandycove Beach, the famous Forty-Foot bathing spot, the Peoples Park, Dún Laoghaire piers and scenic coastal walks all close at hand. Sailing enthusiasts are particularly well catered for, with four yacht clubs and Dún Laoghaire Marina nearby.

Families will appreciate the excellent choice of highly regarded primary and secondary schools in the area, including Dalkey School Project, St Joseph of Cluny, Rathdown School, Loreto Abbey Dalkey and CBC Monkstown, among others.

The area is also very well served by public transport, with the DART, LUAS at Cherrywood, Aircoach and a number of Dublin Bus routes providing convenient connections. The N11 and M50 are easily accessible, offering straightforward access to Dublin City Centre, approximately 12km away, and the surrounding areas.

With its excellent condition, convenient location and particularly private rear garden, 32A Ralahine is a very appealing home with much to offer its new owners.
